Request Shaping

Prompt Inject

Inject a system prompt into requests passing through the gateway without touching the client. Global applies to every request; a combo layers its prompt on top. Use {{combo_name}}, {{display_name}} and {{requested_model}} inside a prompt to fill in names at request time.

Global prompt

Applied to every request, before any combo prompt.
